expectedBehavior: Mutations detect protected branches and dirty worktrees, route changes through an explicit review branch, preserve existing changes, and report the destination branch.
notes: Imported from GitHub #177. The remote artifact incorrectly identifies itself as I-0027; canonical I-0027 is a different human-Verified Issue. Audit remediation assigns this work the collision-free canonical ID I-0031.
observedBehavior: AgileCockpit applies workflow mutations to the checked-out branch and can write directly to a protected default branch.
reproductionSteps: Open a workspace on main, perform a mutating operation such as Sprint close, and observe canonical and projected changes written directly to main.

workItem.title: AgileCockpit should support branch-based workspace mutations
